meta.title: Social + video links — verification record
meta.why: FLAGS.md F-19 and review item R-02 recorded that no restaurant carried an Instagram or TikTok link. Two sessions worked this in parallel on 2026-11-27 (this one and the T18 hotel/verification session); the rows below are the reconciled union, with every handle re-opened before it was kept.
meta.rule: A link is published only when (a) the venue's own official page links to it, or (b) the account itself was opened and its bio/posts tie it to the named venue. A bare guess from a username is never enough. Blank means no account could be tied to the venue.
meta.method: Every URL in this file was opened with the page fetcher on 2026-11-27 and read. Where a platform blocked the fetch, the link is recorded only if an official venue page links to it, and 'evidence' says so.
limits: Instagram follower counts, bios and recent-post lists were read on 2026-11-27; they change.

TikTok returned HTTP 400 to every fetch from this sandbox, so no TikTok link is published on the strength of a TikTok page read. The one TikTok link carried over is linked from the venue's own official footer (F-56).
YouTube channel pages were opened for the two venues listed; a channel returning 'This channel doesn't have any content' is not published (F-57).
A dormant account still documents official footage, but its bio may be years out of date — see the Robuchon note (F-54).

counts.note: counts recomputed 2026-11-27 after the Fountains of Bellagio row (added by another session) gained a property-level Instagram and YouTube channel

meta.supersedes: Review item R-02 ('No restaurant has an Instagram or TikTok link') is **closed** as of 2026-11-27: 21 of 24 restaurants and 5 of 5 activities carry a verified Instagram link, and each row here records how it was confirmed. R-02 remains visible on the Flagged-for-review page as a historical record; this file is the evidence that supersedes it.

restaurants.name: Joël Robuchon
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: bio links mgmgrand.com/en/restaurants/joel-robuchon-french-restaurant.html (this site's official link).
restaurants.caveat: Dormant: newest post 2020-08-07, and the bio still says 'Michelin 3-Star' — the pre-2010 status. The 2026 Guide gives TWO stars (F-54). Do not quote an account bio as a current award.

restaurants.name: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: title 'Latelierjoelrobuchonlv', posts tag @latelierdejoelrobuchonlv and #joelrobuchon #mgmgrand. It is the L'Atelier room's feed.
restaurants.caveat: Dormant: newest post shown 2021-11-21. The obvious alternate handle @latelierdejoelrobuchonlv returns HTTP 404, so this is the right one.

activities.name: Sphere Las Vegas (The Wizard of Oz / concerts)
activities.evidence: Instagram opened and verified-badged ('Sphere', 3.3M followers). YouTube channel opened; lists 'The Wizard of Oz at Sphere' playlists.
activities.also_recorded: Instagram @spherevegas is the account Sphere's own marketing calls its official Instagram account; thesphere.com renders its footer client-side and printed no social links when fetched on 2026-11-27. The TikTok handle is reported as verified in F-53, not re-checked by this session. Source: https://www.instagram.com/spherevegas/

activities.name: High Roller Observation Wheel
activities.evidence: Account opened and verified-badged: 'The High Roller', 'Tallest Observation Wheel in North America', 75,555 followers.
activities.caveat: Official attraction account but dormant — newest post shown 2024-06. The similar handle @highrollerlasvegas is a private 26-follower account and is not used.
activities.also_recorded: Instagram handle @highrollervegas is named as the attraction's account in Caesars Entertainment press material and the profile describes the wheel; the caesars.com attraction page printed only parent-property socials when fetched on 2026-11-27. Source: https://www.instagram.com/highrollervegas/

activities.name: The Mob Museum
activities.evidence: Instagram opened and verified-badged (71,833 followers, bio links admission.themobmuseum.org). YouTube channel opened; lists 'Inside the Life' and 'About The Mob Museum' playlists.
activities.also_recorded: Instagram is declared as the museum's own profile in the metadata of its official YouTube channel, whose declared website is themobmuseum.org; the museum's home page prints no social icons. The YouTube links are the museum's own channel plus three individual videos, all resolved via oEmbed on 2026-11-27 (F-67). Re-checked 2026-11-27. Source: https://www.youtube.com/themobmuseum

activities.name: The Neon Museum
activities.evidence: The TikTok and Instagram links are both printed in neonmuseum.org's own site navigation.
activities.caveat: TikTok returned HTTP 400 to this sandbox, so the TikTok page itself was not read (F-57). YouTube handle @neonmuseum opens but says 'This channel doesn't have any content', so no YouTube link is published.
activities.also_recorded: The museum's own site navigation prints both handles (Instagram and TikTok), so these are the strongest social links on this page. Re-checked 2026-11-27. Source: https://neonmuseum.org/

activities.name: Fremont Street Experience
activities.evidence: Account opened and verified-badged: bio 'Official account of Fremont Street Experience and SlotZilla zipline in downtown #LasVegas'.
activities.caveat: YouTube handle @fremontstreetexperience opens but returns 'This channel doesn't have any content', so no YouTube link is published (F-57).
activities.also_recorded: Instagram is the account whose own profile describes it as the 'Official account of Fremont Street Experience and SlotZilla zipline'; the venue's own site prints no social icons, so no TikTok is listed. Re-checked 2026-11-27. Source: https://www.instagram.com/fremontstreet/

activities.name: Fountains of Bellagio
activities.evidence: Property account: '@bellagio', verified-badged, 489,257 followers, bio 'See the world in a new light and dance with the Fountains' — the fountains are named by the account itself, but this is the resort's feed, not a Fountains-of-Bellagio feed (no such account exists). YouTube @BellagioLasVegas is the property channel and carries '25th Anniversary – Fountains of Bellagio, Las Vegas'; opened 2026-11-27.
